relationships.subject: spared nerve injury
relationships.evidence_quote: SNI in male mice markedly increased Bdnf mRNA expression by 3- and 10-fold over 1 and 2 weeks, respectively

relationships.subject: microglial BDNF
relationships.evidence_quote: Together, these results indicate that depletion of BDNF from microglia reduces dendritic spine remodeling in the S1 after peripheral nerve injury.

relationships.subject: microglial BDNF
relationships.evidence_quote: These data indicate that depletion of microglial BDNF is effective in mitigating peripheral nerve injury–induced S1 activation.

relationships.subject: microglial BDNF
relationships.evidence_quote: removal of BDNF from microglia attenuated mechanical allodynia in SNI mice as compared to nondeleted controls

relationships.subject: microglial BDNF
relationships.evidence_quote: SNI-induced up-regulation of Tnf-α expression in microglia was also reduced in these mice depleted of microglial BDNF

key_findings: Nerve injury upregulates Bdnf mRNA in S1 microglia of male mice; microglia-specific Bdnf deletion (CNS-wide or S1-restricted) prevents spine remodeling, pyramidal neuron hyperactivity and mechanical allodynia.
Microglial Bdnf deletion also reduces SNI-induced microglial Tnf-alpha; cytokine responses differ between males and females.
